profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Bloomberg
profile.summary: An engineer who is unwilling to accept that things can't improve simply because they have always been done a certain way.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- User Data Platform
- Document Store System
- UX / Content Management

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Part of DPAAS (Data Platform As A Service) team that was responsible for ingesting Ads Impression level data. The platform enabled internal users to create reporting, measurement, analytics and billing jobs.
- Creating tooling for Data Platform of the company that ingests ~450 TB data a day.
- Improving performance of a sophisticated workflow orchestration system that runs ~2000 jobs every hour.
- Adding more automation to our cloud export product which sends hourly data feeds to 1000s of clients.
- Improving alerting and monitoring system with Opsgenie for proper oncall alerts routing.
- Working on live data migration across different on prem hadoop cluster as well as S3 and ADLS
- Improved performance of distributed systems by fine tuning rabbitmq config and consumers.-
positions.insights: Skills: Scala · Java · Big Data · RabbitMQ · Hadoop · Python · React.js · JavaScript · Infrastructure

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked on Adstxt crawler that aggregates adstxt data from almost 2 million domains. Responsible for the design and development of lot of features and APIs for the subscribers of the service. 
- Designed and developed a portal for members of the company. The portal acts as central web app to access other products and tools. It's responsible for role based information access to users from video recordings to adstxt data to sdks and what not. 
- Worked on validation tools such as VAST validator and ORTB validator. 
- Actively involved on development of core apis such as login systems and other internal tools.

positions.title: Data Analyst Intern
positions.description:
At Metricle i am responsible for Aggregating analytics and create insightful data visualizations, 
Research and analyze SEC Filings of publicly traded companies and develop trading strategy to implement and Create algorithms to collect the data in an efficient and clean process. I have been working extensively with python, excel and MongoDB.

positions.title: Web Developer Intern
positions.description: Contributed in development of Cloud-based application (DiligenceVault.com) that manages Due-Diligence of Investors and Managers. Created a Parser using Python and Django which generates a meaningful data out of large unstructured data files. Parser would run periodically looking out for changes and updates database accordingly and maintains change history. Worked on frontend in development of Charts using D3 js and angular js with HTML/CSS. I also had a chance to write few APIs using C# .Net gaining overall experience of development of a Web Application.

educations.schoolName: New York University - Polytechnic School of Engineering

volunteerExperiences.description:
Vividhlaxi Audyogik Samshodhan Vikas Kendra (VASVIK) is a non-profit, non-government organisation established in 1974.
Vasvik research awards are presented in categories to scientists and researchers who have excelled in their particular field, organized at CITC.

projects.title: Weather Forecast Browser
projects.description: A Web Application that gives Weather forecasts of city in different line charts such as temperature, humidity and pressure using React js and Redux. APIs used for weather data is openweathermap and to show forecast using charts i used sparklines.

projects.title: Mini Blog
projects.description: Developed a scalable web application using J2EE and Amazon RDS where users can read or write based on a trending topic according to their interest. The trends will be taken using twitter API and reddit API. User can also login using Facebook and write ups shown to them will be based on their likes.
